events.title: Character Spotlight - 🐲 Dragon Princess VI
events.summary: The air is sickly sweet, the lights are dim, the extravagant bed is ready to be the stage for another passion filled night. And yet, the youngest of the Dragon Princesses finds herself unfulfilled. Boredom. Not a single subject had been able to do anything new, anything different. Dragon Princess VI lusts for a special new playmate...~Who’s This Princess?Of the 6 daughters of the Dragon Queen, the youngest is perhaps the most wild and most dangerous of them all. events.title: 💥 Queen of Clubs - Card trading
events.summary: The newly announced feature gets deeper, and it's all ready for the 29th!🃏 Trade your cards, get ones you don't have, or get higher-rarity ones for more copies of the same card your client asks for!💥More features are being prepared right now, stay tuned~

events.title: Demo Update! (10/20)
events.summary: We're listening to you, and this is how fast we work~Frustrated because no needed drink spawns and you don't have an arsenal of items to handle it? Gotchu covered! And I, for one, think it's waaay better like this.Default R-Click skill changed to a "Snipe", switching one of the drinks on the Counter with one that's being asked from one of the clients (or a random one if none's asked)Text Speed options added: Normal / Fast / Instant

events.title: ♣️ Queen of Clubs WIKI
events.summary: Queen of Clubs gets its own Wiki!I've been working on this for a while, and it's finally ready to be shared!A starting guide, a mechanics guide, and a repository for all the items you can obtain in the game, since there's already A LOT of them 💦Live at: princessconquest.com/qoc-wikiCharacters, items, guides, romance progression, hints, rules... all in a single place!If you spot something wrong, or an item that doesn't add up, let me know in the comments or on Discord!Enjoy 🤓
